}}'''Hijacked Blazes''' are the [[:Category:Hijacked Mobs|Hijacked Version]] of Blazes. As opposed to its sane counterpart, the Hijacked Blaze's Rods and head are all stuck together into one central body, with the parasites tentacles reaching out from below.

==''Spawning''==
* Spawned when a Blaze is damaged by a [[Gnat]] or a [[Lice]] when below 50% health.

==''Behavior''==

* Hijacked Blazes attack by slowly firing a projectile at their target which inflicts 3.5 damage and Poison.
* Hijacked Blazes can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 40 tick cooldown and a 2 Block range.

==''Trivia''==

* The [[Gnat]] that infected the blaze can be seen on its model, burrowed into what remains of its head.
* The Hijacked Blaze is the only parasite immune to fire and lava, a common weakness amongst parasites.
